newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Europe bunkers weakened, ARA market confused.
newsitem.headline: Europe bunkers weakened, ARA market confused.

text.p: ARA bunkers dipped, but traded in a wide range, and bunkers in most other ports also weakened on Wednesday, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST traded from $96 to $101 fob amid confusion over the direction of the barge market. Barges traded at $95 fob ARA in the morning, down $4, after a sharp rise late on Tuesday caused by technical problems at a refinery.
Total ARA bunker demand was thin as shipowners deferred purchases in the uncertainty.
Hamburg prices were $1 a tonne lower at $102/$103 fob.
In the Mediterranean, bunkers mostly weakened by $1 to $2 a tonne. Losses in Spain and France drew in some buying after a tranquil start to the week.
"We've seen reasonable demand, although there are of course good avails," one Spanish supplier said.
Saudi Aramco reduced fuel oil bunkers in the Gulf by $2 to $103 and raised gas oil in the Red Sea by $1 to $217.
